Frozen pellets that fall in a storm : Hail
Rotating column of air that reaches the ground : Tornado
Arc of colours seen opposite the sun after rain : Rainbow
Rumble that follows lightning : Thunder
Light, fine rain : Drizzle
Snowstorm driven by strong winds : Blizzard
Seasonal wind that brings a rainy season : Monsoon
Instrument that measures air pressure : Barometer
Moisture content of the air : Humidity
Ice crystals on a cold morning : Frost
Atlantic storm with winds of at least 119 km/h : Hurricane
Flash of electricity in a storm : Lightning
Long spell without rain : Drought
Gentle wind : Breeze
Line on a weather map joining points of equal pressure : Isobar
Temperature scale on which water freezes at zero : Celsius
Visible mass of water droplets in the sky : Cloud
Mix of rain and snow : Sleet
Cloud at ground level : Fog
Droplets on grass at dawn : Dew
